description: Draft the RFP, then evaluate supplied bids using a buyer-approved rubric and hard disqualifiers. Drafted requirements remain provisional. Fixed sequence: rfp (xrfp-drafter, $15) → evaluation (xscore-bid-evaluation, $15). Separate invoices per stage; completed stages remain consumed if a later stage fails. No atomic bundle charge or automatic transfer.

consentExternalProcessing.description: Required: authorize external processing for this workflow.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller key for exactly one logical workflow request.

maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum charge authorized across the recipe; each paid stage still requires its own supplied invoice.

referenceEvidence.description: Supplied reference / case-study evidence; URLs alone are not fetched (optional)

responses.description: Supplier responses with supplier / requirement IDs (required)

documents.description: Demand, current specification and relevant policy (optional)

timeline.description: Issue, Q&A, response, evaluation and decision dates (required)

name: procurement_workflow__rfp_to_bid_review
title: RFP draft → bid evaluation
